blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Speech-to-speech translation should preserve not only what is said, but also who says it and how it is said. Existing end-to-end S2ST, speech MLLM, and cascade systems can preserve content or timbre, but often struggle to realize emotion, tone, rhythm, pauses, and pragmatic attitude in the target language. We propose PACT, a target-space pragmatic prompting framework for expressive and voice-preserving S2ST. PACT extracts source pragmatic cues, projects them into the target-language expression space, calibrates the projected representation to a realizable target subspace, and converts it into continuous prompts for a frozen speech generator. On bidirectional Spanish-English TOPI evaluation, PACT achieves the best overall performance among evaluated systems across content fidelity, voice preservation, and expression preservation metrics.
blocks.zh: 对口相传的翻译不仅应保留所说的话,而且应保留谁说的和如何说的. 现有的端到端的S2ST,语音MLLM,和级联系统可以保留内容或timbre,但往往在目标语言中挣扎去实现情感,语气,节奏,暂停,以及务实的态度. 我们提议PACT,这是一个目标空间实用的激励框架,用于表达和语音保留S2ST。 PACT提取出源实用提示,将其投放到目标语言表达空间中,将预测的表达值校正到可实现的目标子空间,并转换为被冻结的语音生成器的连续提示. 在西班牙语-英语TOPI双向评价中,PACT在内容忠实、语音保存和表达保全指标等被评价系统中取得了最佳的总体业绩。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Speech-to-speech translation (S2ST) is a key technology for cross-lingual communication, real-time interpretation, and expressive media dubbing. For these applications, an S2ST system should preserve not only what is said, but also who says it and how it is said. Beyond semantic fidelity, recent work has increasingly studied expressive and voice-preserving S2ST, where the target speech should retain speaker identity and natural expressive delivery [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 语音对语音翻译(S2ST)是跨语言交流,实时口译,以及表达式媒体配音的关键技术. 对于这些应用,一个S2ST系统不仅应保留所说的话,而且还应保留谁说的以及如何说的. 除了语义忠诚外,最近的工作越来越多地研究表达和语音保留S2ST,其中目标演讲应保留演讲者身份和自然表达送出[1,2,3,4,5,6].

blocks.en: However, cross-lingual expression preservation is not simply a matter of preserving source-side acoustic or style cues. In this work, we use pragmatic cues to refer to paralinguistic cues in speech that help listeners perceive communicative intent, such as affective stance, emphasis, rhythm, pausing, and conversational attitude. The same intent may be realized differently across languages: urgency, sarcasm, or frustration in Spanish may require different pitch movement, pause placement, and emphasis patterns when naturally expressed in English [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] . This target-language realization gap has also been observed in expressive dubbing, cross-lingual prosody transfer, and phrase-level speech translation [ 10 , 11 , 12 ] .
blocks.zh: 然而,跨语言表达方式的保存并不仅仅是保护源侧声调或风格提示的问题. 在这部作品中,我们用实用的提示来指代语言中的抛语提示,这些提示帮助听众感知到沟通意图,如情感姿态,强调,节奏,乏味,和对话态度. 不同语言之间可以不同地实现同样的意图:西班牙语中的紧迫性、讽刺性或挫折感可能要求不同的投球运动、暂停放置和强调模式,而这种模式自然是以英语表达的[7、8、9]。 这一目标语言实现差距也体现在表达性假说,跨语言的流传,以及短语级的语音翻译[10,11,12]中.

blocks.en: Existing end-to-end S2ST, speech MLLM, and cascaded voice/style-cloning systems can preserve content, timbre, or naturalness, but they often lack an explicit mechanism for mapping how source expression should be realized in the target language. This motivates a target-language expression signal for expressive and voice-preserving S2ST.
blocks.zh: 现有的端对端S2ST,语音MLLM,以及级联语音/风格克隆系统可以保存内容,tibre,或自然性,但它们往往缺乏一个明确的机制来绘制如何在目标语言中实现源表达. 这激发了一种目标语言表达信号,用于表达和语音保留S2ST.

blocks.en: We propose PACT , short for Pragmatic Alignment with Calibrated Target-space Prompting , a framework for expressive and voice-preserving S2ST. PACT separates generation into three complementary channels: a semantic channel for target-language text, a speaker channel for voice identity, and a pragmatic prompting channel for utterance-level expression. The pragmatic channel maps source pragmatic cues into a target-language expression space, calibrates the projected representation to a realizable target subspace, and converts it into continuous prompts for a frozen speech generator.
blocks.zh: 我们提出PACT,简称为实用校准目标空间提示(Pracmatic unitation with Calified target-space Pointing),是表达和语音保留S2ST的框架. PACT将生成分为三个互补的频道:目标语言文本的语义频道,语音身份的扬声器频道,以及实用的发音级别表达的提示频道. 实用的通道将源实用的提示映射到目标语言表达空间,将预测的表示值校准到可实现的目标子空间,并将其转换成持续提示的冷冻语音生成器.

blocks.en: We evaluate PACT on the bidirectional Spanish–English TOPI benchmark, which provides paired source speech and human target-language reenactments for measuring expressive S2ST. We compare PACT with end-to-end S2ST systems, speech MLLMs, and cascaded expressive TTS systems under a unified speech-output evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 我们用双向西班牙语-英语TOPI基准来评价PACT,该基准提供配对源语言和人类目标语言的再现,用于测量表达式S2ST. 我们比较了PACT与端到端的S2ST系统,语音MLLM,以及按照统一语音输出评价协议的级联的表达式TTS系统.

blocks.en: The primary contributions of this paper are threefold: • We formulate expressive and voice-preserving S2ST as target-language expression realization, and propose PACT, a target-space pragmatic prompting framework that separates semantic translation, speaker preservation, and utterance-level expression control. • We introduce realization-calibrated pragmatic prompting, which maps source pragmatic cues into a target-language expression space, constrains them to a realizable target subspace, and injects them as continuous prompts into a frozen speech generator. • We demonstrate state-of-the-art overall performance on the bidirectional Spanish–English TOPI benchmark, with consistent gains across content fidelity, voice preservation, and expression preservation metrics.
blocks.zh: 本文件的主要贡献有三: 我们制定表达式和语音保留S2ST作为目标语言表达实现,并提议PACT,一个目标空间实用的激励框架,将语义翻译,语音保存,语音级表达控制区分开来. 我们引入了可实现校正的实用提示,将实用提示映射到目标语言表达空间中,将其限制在可实现的目标子空间中,并将它们作为连续的提示注入冷冻的语音生成器中. ^ 我们在双向西班牙语-英语TOPI基准上展现出最先进的总体表现,在内容忠实、语音保存和表达保全指标方面都取得了一致的进展。

blocks.en: We formulate expressive and voice-preserving S2ST as target-language expression realization, and propose PACT, a target-space pragmatic prompting framework that separates semantic translation, speaker preservation, and utterance-level expression control.
blocks.zh: 我们制定表达式和语音保留S2ST作为目标语言表达实现,并提议PACT,一个目标空间实用的激励框架,将语义翻译,语音保存和语音级别的表达控制区分开来.

blocks.en: We introduce realization-calibrated pragmatic prompting, which maps source pragmatic cues into a target-language expression space, constrains them to a realizable target subspace, and injects them as continuous prompts into a frozen speech generator.
blocks.zh: 我们引入实现校正实用的提示, 将实用的提示映射到目标语言表达空间, 将其限制在可实现的目标子空间, 并注入到一个冷冻的语音生成器中。

blocks.en: We demonstrate state-of-the-art overall performance on the bidirectional Spanish–English TOPI benchmark, with consistent gains across content fidelity, voice preservation, and expression preservation metrics.
blocks.zh: 我们在双向西班牙语-英语TOPI基准上展现出最先进的总体表现,在内容忠实、语音保存和表达保全指标方面都取得了一致的进展。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: Expressive and voice-preserving S2ST. Recent S2ST systems increasingly aim to preserve not only linguistic content, but also speaker identity and expressive delivery. Translatotron-style and direct S2ST models study voice-preserving speech translation without relying entirely on text-only generation [ 1 , 13 ] . SeamlessExpressive extends multilingual S2ST toward vocal style and prosody preservation through prosody-aware unit generation and cross-lingual expressivity modeling [ 2 ] . Recent systems such as UniSS further explore unified modeling for preserving timbre, emotion, and duration consistency [ 5 ] . Discrete-unit and style-transfer S2ST methods improve cross-lingual speech generation by modeling target speech units or additional acoustic/style representations [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] . These approaches demonstrate the importance of expressive S2ST, but expression transfer is typically handled implicitly through end-to-end generation, unit prediction, style embeddings, or source-speech prompting. In contrast, PACT explicitly formulates expression transfer as target-space pragmatic prompting.
blocks.zh: 表达式和语音保持S2ST. 最近的S2ST系统日益致力于不仅保留语言内容,而且保留扬声器特性和表达式表达方式. Translatotron风格和直接S2ST模型研究保留语音语音翻译,而不完全依赖文本唯一的生成[1,13]. 无缝 表达式将多语种S2ST扩展至声调风格和音质保存,通过音质感单元生成和跨语言表达式模型[2]. 近代的系统如UniSS进一步探索统一模型,以保留tibre,情感,以及持续时间的一致性[5]. discrete-unit and style-transfer S2ST方法通过建模目标语音单元或额外的声学/风格表达[13,14,15]来改进跨语言语音生成. 这些方法证明了表达式S2ST的重要性,但表达式转移通常通过端到端生成,单位预测,样式嵌入,或源语提示来隐含处理. 相比之下,PACT则明确将表达式的转移作为目标空间实用的提示.

blocks.en: Prompt-conditioned generation and speech MLLMs. Cascaded ASR/MT plus prompt-conditioned TTS systems provide a practical route to expressive S2ST by combining strong text translation with voice or style cloning. Fish-Speech uses reference-audio tokens for token-prompted in-context TTS [ 16 ] ; OpenVoice supports tone-color cloning and flexible style control [ 17 ] ; and XTTS-v2 enables cross-lingual voice cloning from a short reference clip [ 18 ] . Recent speech MLLM and live-translation systems, such as Qwen3.5-LiveTranslate, further expose speech-to-speech generation and voice-cloning capabilities [ 19 ] . These systems provide strong generation backbones and voice/style prompts, but their public interfaces do not explicitly map source-language pragmatic cues into a target-language expression space. PACT fills this gap by keeping the speech generator frozen while projecting, calibrating, and prompting with target-space pragmatic representations.
blocks.zh: 快速有条件的生成和语音 MLLMs. Cascaded ASR/MT 加上即时条件的TTS系统,通过将强文本翻译与语音或风格克隆相结合,为表达S2ST提供了实用的路线. Fish-Speech使用参考-audio符号来表示符号提示式的缩写 TTS [16];OpenVoice支持调色克隆和灵活风格控制 [17];和XTTS-v2允许从一个简短的参考片段进行跨语言语音克隆 [18]. 近期的语音MLLM和现场翻译系统,如Quen3.5-LiveTranslate,进一步暴露了语音对语音生成和语音克隆能力[19]. 这些系统提供了强大的生成主干线和语音/风格的提示,但其公共界面没有明确将源语言实用提示映射到目标语言表达空间. PACT通过在投射,校准和提示目标空间实用表述时保持语音生成器的冻结来填补这一空白.

blocks.en: III Proposed Method
blocks.zh: 三 拟议方法

blocks.en: We propose PACT (Pragmatic Alignment with Calibrated Target-space Prompting), a modular framework for expressive and voice-preserving speech-to-speech translation. Given a source utterance in language ℓ s \ell_{s} and a target language ℓ t \ell_{t} , PACT separates generation into three complementary channels: a semantic channel for translated linguistic content, a speaker channel for voice identity preservation, and a pragmatic prompting channel for utterance-level expression control. The three channels are fused only at synthesis time through a frozen speech generator, as illustrated in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 我们提议PACT(与校准目标空间促进的实用校正),这是表达和语音保留语音对语音翻译的模块化框架。 PACT将生成分为三个互补渠道:翻译语言内容的语义频道、语音身份保护的扬声器频道,以及实用的促进表达式控制频道。 如图1所示,这三个信道只在合成时通过冷冻的语音生成器连接。

blocks.en: Unlike approaches that rely primarily on source-side audio, speaker, or style conditioning, PACT maps source pragmatic cues into the target-language expression space before using them to guide speech generation. This design allows the generated target speech to preserve the source speaker’s voice while faithfully realizing the source utterance’s paralinguistic intent in the target language.
blocks.zh: 与主要依赖源侧音频,扬声器或风格配置的方法不同,PACT地图在使用它们来引导语音生成之前,会向目标语言表达空间提供实用提示. 这种设计使生成的目标语音能够保留源发音,同时忠实地实现源发音在目标语言中的准语言意图.

blocks.en: III-A Semantic Channel
blocks.zh: 语义频道

blocks.en: The semantic channel produces the target-language text that conditions speech generation. We first transcribe the source-language speech using Whisper Large V3 [ 20 ] , and then translate the transcript into the target language using Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct [ 21 ] . This cascade is used solely to provide the linguistic content for synthesis; speaker identity and expressive control are handled by the speaker-conditioning and pragmatic prompting channels described below. For same-backbone ablations, we use the same cached translations across all variants, ensuring that differences in the generated speech can be attributed to the prompting and synthesis components rather than to changes in the translated text.
blocks.zh: 语义频道生成目标语言文本,为语音生成提供条件. 我们首先使用Whisper Lige V3 [20] 翻译出源语言的语音,然后使用Quen2.5-72B-Instruct [21] 翻译成目标语言. 该级联仅用于提供合成语言内容;演讲者身份和表达控制由演讲者空调和下文所述的实用提示渠道处理。 对于同一种背骨拼音,我们使用所有变体的相同缓存翻译,确保生成的语音的差异可以归因于提示和合成组件,而不是翻译文本的修改.

blocks.en: III-B Speaker Channel
blocks.zh: 发言人频道

blocks.en: To preserve the source speaker’s voice identity, PACT uses the native source-audio speaker-conditioning interface of CosyVoice 3 [ 22 ] . Given the source utterance x s x_{s} , the speaker channel extracts a speaker condition v s v_{s} , which is provided to the speech generator as a separate conditioning signal from the pragmatic prompt. This separation is important: the speaker channel captures relatively stable speaker identity and timbre, whereas the pragmatic prompting channel controls utterance-level paralinguistic realization in the target language.
blocks.zh: 为了保留源发言人的语音身份,PACT使用CosyVoice 3 [22]的原生源-音频发言人-空调接口. 鉴于源词 x s x_{s} , 扬声器频道提取一个扬声器条件 v s_{s} , 提供给语音生成器, 作为与实用提示的单独的调制信号 。 这种分离很重要:扬声道能捕捉相对稳定的扬声器身份和潮流,而实用的导导道则能控制目标语言的语音层次的准语言实现.

blocks.en: III-C Pragmatic Prompting Channel
blocks.zh: III-C 实用提示通道

blocks.en: The pragmatic prompting channel is the core of PACT. It converts source-side pragmatic cues into a target-language prompt representation that can guide a frozen speech generator.
blocks.zh: 务实的提示渠道是PACT的核心. 它将源边实用提示转换为目标语言的即时表示,可以引导冷冻的语音生成器.

blocks.en: III-D Training and Inference
blocks.zh: 三-D 培训和推论

blocks.en: PACT uses CosyVoice 3 [ 22 ] as the target speech generator and keeps it fully frozen throughout training and inference. We do not fine-tune its language model, speech tokenizer, speaker-conditioning pathway, or waveform decoder. Instead, PACT estimates or trains only the components required to produce pragmatic soft prompts: the cross-lingual projector, the realization calibration statistics, and the pragmatic adapter. This makes the method parameter-efficient and preserves the generator’s pre-trained speech synthesis capability, ensuring that performance gains come from target-space pragmatic prompting rather than from training a larger or domain-specific speech generator.
blocks.zh: PACT使用CosyVoice 3[22]作为目标语音生成器,并在整个培训和推论中保持全冷. 我们没有微调其语言模型、语音标语器、扬声器空调路径或波形解码器。 相反,PACT只估计或训练生产实用软提示所需的组件:跨语言投影仪,实现校准统计,以及实用的适配器. 这使得方法参数效率高,并保持了发电机预先训练的语音合成能力,确保性能收益来自目标空间务实的激励,而不是来自培训更大的或特定领域的语音生成器.

No statistics from the evaluation split are used for projector fitting or calibration.

blocks.en: IV Experiments
blocks.zh: 四 试验

blocks.en: IV-A Implementation and Training Details
blocks.zh: 执行和培训细节

blocks.en: We split the DRAL training portion into 2,577 training pairs and 286 development pairs. Since the Emilia subset used here does not contain Spanish speech, the two directions use different adapter-training protocols. For Spanish-to-English, the English-target adapter is pre-trained on a 400-hour Emilia subset for 8 epochs and fine-tuned on DRAL for 30 epochs. For English-to-Spanish, the Spanish-target adapter is trained only on DRAL for 30 epochs. In both directions, only the pragmatic adapter is updated and the CosyVoice 3 generator remains frozen.
blocks.zh: 我们把DRAL培训部分分为2,577个培训对和286个开发对. 由于这里使用的Emilia子集并不包含西班牙语语音,因此这两个方向使用不同的适配器-训练协议. 对于西班牙语对英语,英语目标适配器在400小时的Emilia子集上预训8个epochs,在DRAL上微调30个epochs. 对于英语对西班牙语,西班牙语目标适配器只接受过30个世纪的DRAL训练. 在两个方向上,只有实用的适配器被更新,CosyVoice 3发电机仍然被冻结.

blocks.en: The pragmatic adapter is a lightweight MLP that maps a target-space pragmatic vector into seven 896-dimensional continuous prompt tokens. It uses a 512-dimensional hidden size with GELU activations and LayerNorm, and contains approximately 3.5M trainable parameters. For each direction, we fit a 64-component scaled PLS projector on paired pragmatic vectors from the DRAL training split, mapping 101 → \rightarrow 103 dimensions for Spanish-to-English and 103 → \rightarrow 101 for English-to-Spanish.
blocks.zh: 实用适配器是一种轻量级的MLP,它将目标空间实用矢量映射为7个896维连续的即时符号. 它使用512维隐藏大小,带有GELU激活和TyleNorm,并包含约3.5M可列车参数. 对于每个方向,我们安装一个64个组件的PLS投影仪,对DRAL训练分拆的对等实用矢量投影仪,绘制了101 ~\右侧103维的西班牙语对英语,103 →\右侧101度的英语对西班牙语。

blocks.en: Target-space realization calibration is applied only in Spanish-to-English, where the English-target adapter benefits from Emilia pre-training. It uses the target-language training mean and the PLS target subspace, with k = 64 k=64 and α = 0.25 \alpha=0.25 . For English-to-Spanish, we disable calibration based on development-set performance and use the PLS-projected Spanish vector directly, avoiding over-constraining the DRAL-only Spanish target-space prompt representation.
blocks.zh: 目标空间实现校准只在西班牙语对英语中应用,英语目标适配器从艾米利亚预训中受益. 它使用目标语言训练平均值和PLS目标子空间,其中k=64 k=64,α=0.25\alpha=0.25. 对于英语对西班牙语,我们基于开发设置的性能而禁用校准,直接使用PLS预测的西班牙语矢量,避免过度训练DRAL唯一的西班牙语目标空间即时表示.

blocks.en: The adapter is optimized with Adam using a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 5 1\times 10^{-5} , 1,000 warm-up steps, gradient clipping of 5, and gradient accumulation of 2. The prompt length is selected from m ∈ { 1 , 3 , 5 , 7 , 9 , 11 , 13 , 15 } m\in\{1,3,5,7,9,11,13,15\} on the development set, with m = 7 m=7 used in the final system. All waveforms are generated at 24 kHz. Architecture choices, projector variants, calibration settings, and checkpoints are selected on the development set; the evaluation split is used only for final reporting. All training and inference are conducted on a single NVIDIA RTX 5090.

blocks.en: IV-B Benchmark and Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 基准和评价议定书

blocks.en: We evaluate PACT on the released TOPI Spanish–English benchmark [ 24 , 8 ] . The benchmark consists of paired Spanish–English utterances that are closely matched for communicative intent: bilingual speakers first participate in spontaneous conversations and then re-create selected utterances in the other language. Because spontaneous conversational speech naturally contains rich affective and pragmatic cues, this design makes the benchmark particularly suitable for expressive S2ST. The paired target-language reenactments provide human references for evaluating lexical content, speaker consistency, and target-language realization of paralinguistic and pragmatic intent. In our experiments, we use the 30 bilingual evaluation pairs for which target-language transcriptions are available, and evaluate both Spanish-to-English and English-to-Spanish directions.
blocks.zh: 我们评价PACT在发行的TOPI西班牙语–英语基准 [24, 8]. 该基准由西班牙语和英语的对等词组成,这些词与沟通意图非常吻合:双语演讲者首先参与自发对话,然后用其他语言重新制作选定的词汇。 由于自发的谈话演说自然包含丰富的感人和实用的提示,这种设计使得基准特别适合表达S2ST. 配对的目标语重现为评价词汇内容、语音一致性以及实现准语言主义和务实意图的目标语提供了人类参考。 在我们的实验中,我们使用30对双语评价对,这些评价对有目标语言的抄本,并评价西班牙语对英语和英语对西班牙语的方向。

blocks.en: IV-C Compared Systems
blocks.zh: 比较系统

blocks.en: We compare PACT against three complementary baseline families. End-to-end S2ST systems include SeamlessExpressive and SeamlessM4T-v2 [ 2 ] , Fairseq S2UT [ 13 , 14 ] , and Qwen3.5-LiveTranslate [ 19 ] , covering expressive, unit-based, and voice-preserving S2ST paradigms. Speech MLLM systems include Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus [ 25 ] and GPT-Audio-1.5 [ 26 ] . Cascaded systems combine ASR/MT with OpenVoice V2 [ 17 ] , Fish-Speech / OpenAudio S1-mini [ 16 ] , or XTTS-v2 [ 18 ] . For PACT and all cascaded baselines, we use the same cached ASR/MT target text so that differences mainly reflect target-speech generation, speaker preservation, and expressive realization rather than upstream transcription or translation.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了PACT与三个互补基线家庭. 端到端的S2ST系统包括SeamlessExpressive和SeamlessM4T-v2[2],Fairseq S2UT[13,14],以及Quen3.5-Live Translate[19],涵盖表达,单位,和语音保存的S2ST范式. Speech MLLM系统包括Qune3.5-Omni-Plus [25]和GPT-Audio-1.5 [26]. 连锁系统将ASR/MT与OpenVoice V2 [17],Fish-Speech / OpenAudio S1-mini [16],或XTTS-v2 [18]结合. 对于PACT和所有级联基线,我们使用相同的缓存ASR/MT目标文本,以便差异主要反映目标语音生成、语音保存和表达性实现,而不是上游的抄录或翻译。

blocks.en: IV-D Metrics
blocks.zh: 四-D 计量

blocks.en: We use a multi-dimensional target-referenced evaluation suite covering content fidelity, voice preservation, and expression preservation. Except for ASR-BLEU, all objective metrics are computed between the generated speech and the corresponding human target-language reference. For content fidelity, we transcribe generated speech with Whisper Large V3 [ 20 ] and compute BLEU [ 27 ] against the human target-language reference transcription, denoted as ASR-BLEU. For voice preservation, we compute target-referenced speaker similarity (Spk Sim.) as the cosine similarity between WavLM-Large embeddings [ 28 ] of generated and reference speech. This target-referenced protocol is appropriate for evaluation because the reference recordings are target-language reenactments of the same communicative intent, allowing us to evaluate target-language realization without relying on cross-lingual acoustic matching.
blocks.zh: 我们使用一个多维目标参考评价套件,涵盖内容忠实、声音保存和表达保存。 除了ASR-BLEU之外,所有客观的衡量标准都是在生成的语音和相应的人类目标语言参考之间计算出来的. 对于内容的忠诚,我们用Whisper Lige V3 [20] 转录生成的语音,并对照人类目标语言的参考语录计算BLEU [27],表示为ASR-BLEU. 为了语音保存,我们计算目标参考的扬声器相似性(Spk Sim.)作为WavLM-Large嵌入生成语和参考语[28]的共弦相似性. 这个目标参考协议适合评价,因为参考录音是目标语言重现了相同的交流意图,使我们能够评价目标语言实现而无需依赖跨语言的声学匹配.

blocks.en: For expression preservation, we report the TOPI pragmatic similarity metric (Prag Sim.) [ 7 , 24 ] , computed between generated and reference speech. We also report complementary expressive-speech diagnostics: SER-JSD, the Jensen–Shannon divergence between SUPERB emotion-recognition probability distributions [ 29 ] ; Emo Sim., the cosine similarity between Emotion2Vec embeddings [ 30 ] ; eG-Z, the Z-normalized RMSE between eGeMAPS functionals [ 31 ] extracted with openSMILE [ 32 ] ; and Dur. Ratio, defined as min ⁡ ( d gen / d ref , d ref / d gen ) \min(d_{\mathrm{gen}}/d_{\mathrm{ref}},d_{\mathrm{ref}}/d_{\mathrm{gen}}) .
blocks.zh: 为了保留表达式,我们报告在生成语和参考语之间计算的TOPI实用相似度度量衡(Prag Sim.) [7, 24]. 我们还报告补充性表达式诊断:SER-JSD,SUPERB情感识别概率分布[29]之间的Jensen-Shannon差异;Emo Sim.,情感2Vec嵌入[30]之间的同位素相似性;eG-Z,eGMAPS功能[31]从开放的SMILE[32]中提取的Z-正态RMSE;Dur.比率,定义为:min ⁡(d gen / d ref / d gen)\min(d mathrm{gen}}/d_{\mathrm{ref}},d_{\mathrm{ref}}/d_{\mathrm{gen}})\. 。 。 。

blocks.en: IV-E Main Results
blocks.zh: 四-E 主要成果

blocks.en: Table I presents the main bidirectional results on the TOPI Spanish–English benchmark. PACT establishes state-of-the-art performance among all evaluated systems, achieving the strongest overall performance across translation fidelity, target-language pragmatic realization, voice preservation, and expressive-speech diagnostics. In particular, PACT consistently leads on the three primary axes of expressive S2ST: ASR-BLEU, Pragmatic Similarity, and target-referenced Speaker Similarity in both translation directions.
blocks.zh: 表一列出TOPI西班牙语-英语基准的主要双向结果。 PACT在所有被评价的系统中建立最先进的业绩,实现翻译忠心、目标语言实用实现、语音保存和表达式诊断方面最强的整体业绩。 特别是,PACT在表达S2ST的三个主要轴上始终领先:ASR-BLEU,实用相似性,以及目标参考的议长在两个翻译方向上的相似性.

blocks.en: Balanced expressive S2ST performance. The main advantage of PACT is not limited to a single metric. Compared with all evaluated baselines, PACT substantially improves ASR-BLEU while also preserving stronger pragmatic and speaker similarity. This indicates that target-space pragmatic prompting does not trade off semantic fidelity for expressiveness; instead, it improves the final speech output while maintaining accurate target-language content.
blocks.zh: 平衡表达式S2ST性能. PACT的主要优势不仅限于一个计量标准. 与所有评估的基线相比,PACT大大改进了ASR-BLEU,同时也保持了更强的实用性和扬声器相似性. 这表明,目标空间务实的激励并不能用语义上的忠诚来换取表达;相反,它可以改进最后的语音输出,同时保持目标语言的准确内容。

blocks.en: Target-language pragmatic realization. PACT’s advantage is most evident when content fidelity, voice preservation, and expression preservation are considered jointly. Several baselines are competitive on individual expression-related metrics: SeamlessExpressive obtains a strong Pragmatic Similarity score in the English-to-Spanish direction, and Fish-Speech performs well on SER-JSD and duration matching. However, these systems do not achieve the same balance across ASR-BLEU, Pragmatic Similarity, Speaker Similarity, and complementary emotion/prosody diagnostics. This supports our central hypothesis that expressive S2ST benefits from an explicit target-language pragmatic control signal, rather than relying only on generic speech prompting or voice/style cloning.
blocks.zh: 目标语言务实实现. PACT的优点最明显, 几个基线在个人表达相关衡量标准上具有竞争力: SeamlessExpressive在英语对西班牙语方向上获得一个强大的Pracmatic相似度分数,Fish-Speech在SER-JSD和持续时间匹配上表现良好. 然而,这些系统在ASR-BLEU、实用相似性、议长相似性以及互补情感/prosody诊断方面没有达到同样的平衡。 这支持我们的核心假设,即表达式S2ST从一个明确的目标语言实用的控制信号中获益,而不是仅仅依靠一般的语音提示或语音/风格的克隆.

blocks.en: Comparison with cascaded and MLLM baselines. Cascaded systems such as Fish-Speech, OpenVoice V2, and XTTS-v2 benefit from strong ASR/MT and voice- or style-prompted synthesis, and they are competitive on individual metrics. Nevertheless, they remain less reliable in jointly preserving content, voice identity, and pragmatic intent. Speech MLLM systems produce fluent speech in many cases, but show weaker control over target-referenced speaker and expression similarity. These results demonstrate that PACT’s explicit target-space pragmatic prompting provides a more effective control mechanism for expressive and voice-preserving S2ST.
blocks.zh: 与级联和MLLM基线的比较。 Fish-Speech、OpenVoice V2和XTTS-v2等连锁系统受益于强大的ASR/MT和语音或风格促动合成,它们在单个衡量标准上具有竞争力。 然而,在共同维护内容、声音特征和务实意图方面,它们仍然不那么可靠。 Speech MLLM系统在许多情况下能产生流利的语音,但显示对目标参考的扬声器和表达相似性的控制较弱. 这些结果表明,PACT明确的目标空间务实的激励为表达和语音保留S2ST提供了更有效的控制机制。

blocks.en: IV-F Subjective Evaluation
blocks.zh: 四、主题评价

blocks.en: We further conduct a subjective evaluation on the Spanish-to-English direction to complement the objective metrics. From the 30 evaluation pairs, we randomly select 10 utterances. For each utterance, the evaluation set contains the human English target reference recording and the English speech generated by five systems.
blocks.zh: 我们还对西班牙语对英语方向进行主观评估,以补充客观的衡量标准。 从30个评价对,我们随机选择10个词. 对于每段语音,评价集包含人类英语目标参考录制和五个系统生成的英语语音.

blocks.en: Five proficient English speakers rate each generated utterance on a 1-to-5 MOS scale along three dimensions: pragmatic similarity, speaker similarity, and naturalness. Pragmatic similarity measures whether the generated speech matches the reference in expression-related cues such as emotion, urgency, emphasis, rhythm, and conversational attitude. Speaker similarity measures whether the generated speech sounds like the same speaker as the English reference. Naturalness evaluates the generated speech itself, focusing on fluency, intelligibility, and the absence of audible artifacts.
blocks.zh: 五个精通 讲英语的人按1至5分的MOS比例,按三个方面来评分:实用的相似性、讲词的相似性和自然性。 实用性相似度衡量生成的语音是否与情感,紧迫性,强调性,节奏和对话态度等表达相关提示中的引用相匹配. 演讲者相似度衡量生成的演讲听起来是否与英文参考词相同. 自然性评价生成的语音本身,注重流利,不通晓,缺乏声优的文物.

blocks.en: As shown in Table II , PACT receives the highest subjective scores for both pragmatic similarity and speaker similarity. Across the subjective-evaluation samples, the objective Prag Sim. reported in Table I correlates significantly with human-rated pragmatic similarity, with Pearson r = 0.413 r=0.413 ( p = 0.0029 p=0.0029 ) and Spearman ρ = 0.414 \rho=0.414 ( p = 0.0028 p=0.0028 ), supporting its use as the primary automatic pragmatic metric while motivating our complementary subjective and expressive-speech evaluations. Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus receives the highest naturalness score, consistent with its strong speech generation quality, but it is substantially weaker in target-referenced speaker similarity and pragmatic delivery. This result suggests that PACT’s gains in objective pragmatic and speaker metrics correspond to perceptible improvements, while also showing that naturalness and expression preservation are not identical objectives.
blocks.zh: 如表二所示,PACT在实用相似性和扬声器相似性两方面都获得最高主观分数. 在主观评价样本中,表一中报告的目标Prag Sim.与人评价的实用性相似性密切相关,Pearson r = 0.413 r = 0.413 (p = 0.0029 p = 0.0029)和Spearman ρ = 0.414\rho = 0.414 (p = 0.0028 p = 0.0028),支持将Prag Sim作为主要的自动实用性衡量标准,同时激励我们进行互补的主观和表达式评价。 Qun3.5-Omni-Plus获得最高的自然性分数,与其强烈的语音生成质量一致,但在目标参考的扬声器相似性和务实的交付性方面却大大弱化. 这一结果表明,PACT在客观的实用和扬声器衡量标准方面的进步与可察觉的改进相对应,同时也表明自然性和表达性保存并非相同的目标。

blocks.en: IV-G Ablation Study
blocks.zh: IV-G 读取研究

blocks.en: We conduct bidirectional same-backbone ablations to isolate the contribution of pragmatic prompting, target-space projection, realization calibration, and expressive pretraining. All variants use the same semantic channel, the same frozen CosyVoice 3 generator, the same speaker-conditioning interface, and the same decoding settings.
blocks.zh: 我们进行双向同背骨烧伤,以隔离实用的促动、目标空间投射、实现校准和表现性预训的贡献。 所有变体都使用相同的语义通道,相同的冷冻CosyVoice 3生成器,相同的扬声器-空调接口,以及相同的解码设置.

blocks.en: Ablation configurations. Base uses the default CosyVoice TTS generation prompt without any source-conditioned pragmatic prompt. Constant prompt replaces PACT with a learned global soft prompt, independent of the input utterance; this tests whether improvements come merely from adding seven trainable prompt tokens. Source prompt feeds the source-side pragmatic vector directly into the MLP adapter to generate soft prompts, without first projecting it into the target-language pragmatic space. Calibration variant changes the calibration setting relative to the final PACT configuration: it removes realization calibration for Es → \rightarrow En, where the final system uses calibration, and adds realization calibration for En → \rightarrow Es, where the final system disables it based on development-set performance. w/o pretraining removes Emilia pretraining for Es → \rightarrow En; this ablation is not applicable to En → \rightarrow Es because the Spanish-target adapter is already trained only on DRAL.
blocks.zh: 校勘配置. Base 使用默认的 CosyVoice TTS 生成提示,而没有任何源条件的实用提示提示. 恒定速率取代了PACT,它是一个学习过的全球软速率,独立于输入的语句;这种测试是否仅仅是因为增加了七个可训练的速率符号而得到改进. 源即时将源侧实用矢量直接输入MLP适配器以生成软提示,而不首先将其投射到目标语言实用空间. 校准变体相对于最终的PACT配置改变校准设置:它取消了Es →\rightarrow En的实现校准,其中最终系统使用校准,并增加了En →\rightarrow Es的实现校准,其中最终系统基于开发设置的性能使其失效. w/o 预训取消了 Emilia 预训 Es →\rightarrow En;这种预训不适用于 En →\rightarrow Es,因为西班牙-目标适配器已经只接受过 DRAL 的训练.

blocks.en: Ablation results. Table III shows that source-conditioned pragmatic prompting is essential in both directions. The Base and Constant prompt variants perform worse than PACT, indicating that neither the default TTS prompt nor a generic learned prompt provides sufficient utterance-specific pragmatic control. Source prompting improves over these controls, but remains below PACT in both ASR-BLEU and Pragmatic Similarity, supporting the need to map source pragmatic cues into the target-language expression space rather than injecting the source-side vector directly.
blocks.zh: 疏减结果. 表三显示,以来源为条件的务实激励在两方面都至关重要。 碱和常态即时变体的性能比PACT差,表明默认的TTS即时或通用的学问即时不能提供足够的言语特定实用控制. 源提示比这些控制有所改进,但在ASR-BLEU和Pracmatic相似性上仍然低于PACT,支持需要将源提示实际映射到目标语言表达空间,而不是直接向源侧矢量注入.

blocks.en: The calibration results further show that realization calibration should be applied direction-specifically. For Es → \rightarrow En, removing calibration degrades ASR-BLEU, Pragmatic Similarity, and Speaker Similarity, suggesting that the projected English pragmatic vector benefits from being constrained to a realizable target subspace. In contrast, adding the same calibration to En → \rightarrow Es reduces performance relative to the final ReversePLS configuration. This is likely because the Spanish-target adapter is trained only on DRAL without large-scale Spanish expressive pretraining; in this low-resource setting, calibration may over-constrain the target-space prompt representation. Finally, removing Emilia pretraining in Es → \rightarrow En reduces all three metrics, confirming that large-scale expressive speech exposure helps the adapter learn a more stable interface to the frozen generator.
blocks.zh: 校准结果进一步表明,实现校准应针对具体方向进行。 对于 Es →\rightarrow En,去除校正会降解ASR-BLEU,实用相似性,和扬声器相似性,说明预测的英语实用矢量从被限制在一个可实现的目标子空间得到好处. 相对地,在En →\右旋Es中添加相同的校准会比最终的逆PLS配置降低性能. 这可能是因为西班牙-目标适配器只在DRAL上接受训练,而没有大规模西班牙语表达式预训;在这种低资源环境下,校准可能过度限制目标空间的即时表现. 最后,取消Emilia在 Es 的预训 ~\右转 En减少所有三个度量,确认大规模表达式语音曝光有助于适配器学习一个更稳定的与冷冻生成器的接口.

The calibration variant reports w/o calibration for Es → \rightarrow En and w/ calibration for En → \rightarrow Es; — denotes not applicable. Best scores in each direction are in bold .
V Conclusion
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: We presented PACT, a target-space pragmatic prompting framework for expressive and voice-preserving S2ST. PACT maps source pragmatic cues into a calibrated target-language expression space and injects them as continuous prompts into a frozen speech generator. Bidirectional TOPI results and ablations validate target-space projection, direction-specific calibration, and expressive adapter pretraining, with consistent gains in content, speaker, and pragmatic preservation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了PACT,这是一个目标空间实用的激励框架,用于表达和语音保留S2ST。 PACT地图源实用提示进入一个校准的目标语言表达空间,并将它们作为连续提示注入一个冷冻的语音生成器中. 双向TOPI结果和缩写验证目标空间投影,方向特异性校准,以及表达式适配器预训,在内容,扬声器和实用保存方面持续增益.
